title: Request a Workshop
closedMessage: Workshop requests are paused right now. Email directors@badgersupports.org and we'll reply when requests reopen.
intro: Interactive, peer-led workshops on building connection, practical tools and student well-being, for student organizations, residence halls, classrooms and other campus groups with a mainly student audience. We're happy to tailor the content to your group.
Please request at least two weeks ahead. Questions? Email directors@badgersupports.org.

sections.title: About You and Your Group
sections.intro: Workshops can be provided to campus units, student organizations, classes or friend groups, and to individual students at UW–Madison. If you're requesting for yourself, write “Individual” as your affiliation.

sections.title: Workshop
sections.intro: Choose one, or more than one for a blended session.

sections.title: When and Where
sections.intro: List three dates and times that work for your group. Badger Supports can help reserve a room — say so below and include any accommodations the room needs.

sections.intro: Tell us about prior experience with wellness programming, how comfortable the group is discussing mental health, and your goals for the session.

confirmation.title: Request received
body: Thank you for your interest in a Badger Supports workshop. A member of our team will reach out within one week to confirm your request.
confirmation.review: The one-week promise is the Google Form's own wording, not verified with the Programs team.
